item.title: Listen To Your 'First Mind' When It Comes To the Second Amendment
item.description: I'm a Second Amendment supporter—and then some. It's a spiritual and philosophical foundation more than a tactical choice. My support is based upon the God given right of self defense in every sense, from beliefs to setting boundaries to ballistics. Despite this, I personally don't display weaponry unless I'm in a safety situation. Removing nocturnal trespassers or loud loiterers near where I lived came immediately to mind.

item.title: Take a Stand for Purity
item.description: ORLANDO, FL — In today’s culture where people are bombarded with messages that encourage promiscuity, Liberty Counsel is encouraging Christians to take a public stand for purity. The 22nd annual Day of Purity is a campaign that encourages followers of Jesus Christ to wear white on February 14 to publicly promote abstinence and inspire others to save sexual intimacy for marriage.

item.title: Executive bonuses cost taxpayers $201 million last year
item.description: About 98 per cent of government executives took a bonus last year even though departments missed nearly half of their performance targets, according to access-to-information records obtained by the Canadian Taxpayers Federation.

item.title: Ottawa’s use of federal transfers to the provinces discourages health care reform
item.description: VANCOUVER—The federal government has been increasing its fines on provinces for non-compliance with the Canada Health Act (CHA) in recent years, further discouraging provinces from pursuing much-needed reforms, finds a new study published today by the Fraser Institute, an independent, non-partisan Canadian public policy think-tank.

item.title: Civilization Footprints
item.description: The poet Longfellow famously wrote that people who make history leave “footprints on the sands of time.” Unfortunately, no matter how famous a person is, these passing footprints are washed away by furious ocean waves, tides, or intense winds, unless the footprints are somehow petrified.
